display_information.name: Cowork Compass
display_information.description: Log a trip, find out who else is around.
display_information.long_description: Cowork Compass tells you who from Evolution is already in a city you are travelling to. Run /travel to log a trip and you get a private DM listing anyone whose home base or logged travel overlaps with your destination and dates. Run /travel-home to set the city used for that matching, without touching your public bio. It is informational only: nothing is posted to a channel, nobody else is told you are travelling, and the app never offers to make an introduction.

slash_commands.description: Log a trip and see who else is around
